records.text: Like, why don't you throw it out yourself? I can't find a trash can? Throw it out yourself. And it seems that Tyler (Tyler Clancy), as I am told, told a slightly varied story to others, mainly that he was not instructed to do so, but that he did so out of his own volition on a whim because the item had been left behind in his car.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
